name: auto-testing-frontend
description: Auto Tester — Electron desktop app. Point at a remote auto-testing-backend server.

scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build:desktop && concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c cyan,magenta "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.desktop:start: npm run build && npm run build:desktop && electron .
